basis_limit: Policy-supported inference, not an audit of every individual review history; current policies do not independently establish historical compliance.

JMIR: Regular research, review, tutorial and viewpoint articles supported by publisher policy; non-reviewed exceptional types excluded. Individual reviewer reports not audited.
BMC: Research articles and most other scholarly article types undergo review. Applied to ordinary research/review publications, not letters/editorials.
NATURE: Nature Portfolio policy explicitly includes Articles, Analysis, Resources, Reviews and Perspectives. Scientific Reports research policy also checked.
SDATA: Publisher describes peer-reviewed Article/Data Descriptor formats. Ambiguous brief report excluded.
ELSEVIER: Publisher policy calls for external independent review of research articles; regular published research/review identity corroborated. Patterns reviews held out.
PLOS: Regular research publications in PLOS journals; PLOS Biology and Computational Biology editorial/review processes additionally checked. Ambiguous other types held out.
PEERJ: Primary publisher description distinguishes reviewed PeerJ Computer Science from PeerJ Preprints. Included records are published research articles, not preprints.
FRONTIERS: Publisher type table identifies review status of original research, reviews and methods; one included article also names a reviewer.
MDPI: Publisher process describes external review for research; included records are regular research or reviews, not editorials.
GIGA: Journal describes reviewed publications and public review history. Reports not independently audited.
BIB: Journal identifies itself as peer reviewed and describes manuscript review.
BIOINFO: Journal peer-review process checked; published regular research record.
CKJ: Journal review process checked; included methodological review is not an editorial.
SOC: Journal states all articles are rigorously peer reviewed.
DLI: Journal describes independent review of accepted research; editorial/letter exceptions do not apply.
ITD: Journal policy describes independent anonymous expert review. Publisher transfer noted; publication identity comes from DOI/full text.
JAMA: Journal describes reviewed research and JAMA editorial standards.
ERAD: Owning society describes the journal review process.
JEP: Journal states manuscripts ordinarily receive at least two anonymous reviews.
SIM: Journal describes single-anonymous review and reviewed primary research.
AJAG: Journal explicitly marks Research Articles as peer reviewed.
SEE: Journal submission guidelines describe review and editor/reviewer independence; included original research, not commentary.
PPA: Publisher identifies the journal as peer reviewed; included paper is original research.
JOGH: External review covers research and reviews; viewpoints receive in-house assessment. Ambiguous contribution held out.
